hook: i built an app that tells you when a supplement isn't doing anything
caption: most health apps only know how to say yes. this is the screen i'm proudest of.
notes: STRONGEST PRODUCT POST IN THE BATCH. An app willing to return a null result is the entire differentiator. Lead with this one for anything product-led.

slides.text: most health apps only know how to say yes
slides.sub: so i built one that can say no

slides.caption: Ren, verdict screen. Magnesium, 14 nights, deep sleep 1h12m before and 1h14m after. Inside the night-to-night noise, so it grades as no effect.

slides.sub: not “try a higher dose”. not “give it another month”.

slides.text: that sentence costs a supplement company money
slides.sub: which is roughly why nothing else says it

slides.text: half of what's in your cupboard is this screen
slides.sub: you just haven't run it yet

slides.text: an app that can't tell you no isn't measuring anything.
slides.sub: Ren runs one change at a time against your own baseline and grades it, including when the answer is that it did nothing.
